key.name: provider-order
key.description: Order of providers in the top bar and menus. Disabled providers stay in this list.

key.name: hidden-providers
key.description: Providers kept out of the top bar. Order is preserved when they are shown again.

key.name: auto-refresh
key.description: Whether to refresh provider data on a timer.

key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: Minutes between automatic refreshes. The preferences window offers 1, 5, 15, and 30.

key.name: show-provider-names
key.description: Whether the top bar shows the service name next to each icon.

key.name: quota-percent-mode
key.description: Whether quota percentages show remaining or used amounts on the panel button and in the dropdown menu.

key.name: unavailable-display
key.description: How the top bar treats a provider that has no usable quota.

key.name: cached-data
key.description: Whether to keep showing the last successful quota when a later refresh fails. The timestamp is shown only in the menu.

key.name: use-web-icons
key.description: Download provider icons over HTTPS. Icons appear only after a successful download.

key.name: icon-cache-token
key.description: Incremented when the icon cache is cleared so GNOME Shell and preferences reload icons.

key.name: log-level
key.description: Minimum severity stored in the Log tab. Lower levels are discarded and are not backfilled when you lower this setting.
